issues.on_page: Change in Payables 91,171 (Debt Service Fund, Other Financing Sources)
issues.issue: Unusual item printed as an other financing source (reclassified to accounts payable in the reconciliation column); recorded as printed, but a person may want to confirm treatment.

issues.on_page: Schedules also print Actual on GAAP Basis column
issues.issue: Detail uses budgetary-basis actuals (stated in notes); these differ from the GAAP statement (e.g. DS Engineering 145,212 budgetary vs 0 GAAP).

Fiscal agent fees are debt-related; rule puts fees under debt service interest. Debt Service detail Fiscal Agent Fees (detail[19]) also general government, while SID 274/275 used debt service interest for the same item.
Same label is general government in General Fund detail and statement; inconsistent.
Debt Service Fund engineering is likely capitalized construction engineering (GAAP column shows it inside Net Capital Outlay); capital outlay may fit better.
SID utilities are usually street lighting (streets/highways); judgment call.
Function assigned by judgment (listed by object); could be streets/highways.
